mapper.insert: INSERT INTO filter_presets (preset_name, start_year_month, end_year_month, categories) VALUES (#{presetName}, #{startYearMonth}, #{endYearMonth}, #{categories})
mapper.select: SELECT preset_id AS presetId, preset_name AS presetName, start_year_month AS startYearMonth, end_year_month AS endYearMonth, categories FROM filter_presets ORDER BY preset_id DESC
